steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event without searching for or creating another event.

args.goal: On Project Details, click the open-in-new-tab icon beside the Stage Title and leave the newly opened stage page active, showing the stage tabs, countdown and Settings control

steps.note: Perform the specific open-in-new-tab interaction that no dedicated domain step names.
Continue in the newly opened stage-page tab.
Verify the stage page has the Responses tab.
Verify the stage page has the Overview tab.
Verify the stage page has the Participants tab.
Verify the stage page has the Analytics tab.
Verify the stage page has the Price Trends tab.
Verify the stage page has the Participant Remarks tab.
Verify the stage page exposes the Settings control.
